challenge: NASA International Space Apps Challenge — Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data

resources.name: NASA POWER (Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources — Agroclimatology)
resources.roleInFieldShift: Drives the daily soil-water balance, GDD phenology, Hargreaves ET0, and heat/frost stress simulation across 25 real seasons.

resources.name: NASA Terra/Aqua MODIS Vegetation Indices (MOD13Q1 v061)
resources.roleInFieldShift: Independent satellite validation of simulated water×heat stress (r check in LU8), drought-replay canopy greenness curve, and 4-year parcel underperformance signal.

resources.name: NASA SMAP L4 Global 3-hourly 9 km Root-Zone Soil Moisture (SPL4SMGP v007)
resources.roleInFieldShift: Calibrates off-season soil-water recharge and starting plant-available water at sowing.

resources.name: NASA ISS ECOSTRESS Evaporative Stress Index L4 (ECO_L4T_ESI v002)
resources.roleInFieldShift: Field-scale (70 m) thermal evaporative stress verification during mid-summer flowering.

resources.name: NASA NASADEM Merged DEM Global 1 arc second (NASADEM_NC v001)
resources.roleInFieldShift: Computes parcel slope (%) for curve-number surface runoff and RUSLE topographic factor (LS).

resources.name: NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 Downscaled Climate Projections
resources.roleInFieldShift: Provides the ensemble median and p10–p90 ΔT and ΔP trajectories for the 2050 stress test, 'Safe until ~20XX' margin year, and Quant Monte Carlo engine.

resources.name: NASA/USGS Harmonized Landsat Sentinel-2 (HLS L30/S30) & ESA Copernicus Sentinel-2
resources.roleInFieldShift: Enables high-resolution ('from above') visual field-parcel boundaries, parcel-level NDVI/NDMI health badges, and ESA Partner Award eligibility.

resources.name: NASA/JAXA GPM IMERG Global Precipitation Measurement (IMERG Final Run v07)
resources.roleInFieldShift: Cross-checks extreme convective storm intensity and validates the RUSLE rainfall erosivity factor (R) on sloped fields.

resources.name: NASA GRACE / GRACE-FO Mascon Terrestrial Water Storage & Groundwater Anomaly
resources.roleInFieldShift: Measures long-term regional aquifer depletion (e.g. -2.1 cm/yr in Kansas High Plains) to warn farmers when groundwater irrigation investments face aquifer exhaustion.

resources.name: NASA/USDA CropCASMA & NASA Harvest (GEOGLAM Crop Monitor)
resources.agency: NASA Applied Sciences / USDA NASS / NASA Harvest
resources.resolution: 1 km SMAP + 250 m MODIS cropland mask
resources.roleInFieldShift: Provides sub-county 1 km topsoil moisture anomaly and GEOGLAM regional crop condition benchmark.

resources.name: NASA GIBS (Global Imagery Browse Services) & NASA Worldview WMTS
resources.roleInFieldShift: Renders live satellite overlays directly on the interactive farm map.

resources.name: ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0 Global Soil Information
resources.roleInFieldShift: Provides texture and organic carbon for Saxton–Rawls plant-available water (TAW), RUSLE erodibility (K), and topsoil carbon stocks.
